Baby Bean

Bean is ALIVE — he wiggles, kicks, smiles, and cries right on the stage! Watch him drink his bottle, dance to your song, kick through a pamper change, splash in the bath, and rock off to sleep. Feed him, feed him, feed him! Stop feeding and Bean cries. Sing and Bean forgets about eating for a little while — but when the song stops, it's feeding time again. And hurry with that pamper!
